text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: For so, so long. …Ever since I was very small, you were always by my side.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Uu, uuu… I don’t like the rain… sniff…!
choice_data_list: <size=32>Buena, I found you!… Come on, let’s go home together</size>

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Ah, big brother! Wah… you’re all soaked…! Are you okay? Did you… look for me a lot…?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Ah, big sister! Wah… you’re all soaked…! Are you okay? Did you… look for me a lot…?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Clutching the umbrella meant for me, while getting drenched yourself. Even so, you always came for me— the crybaby, spoiled little me.

text_block_list.name: Buena’s Mother
text_block_list.text: …So, there’s a race next month for lower-grade elementary kids. What do you think? …Do you want to try entering?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I want to try… I want to run! And then—…Hey, Mom.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: If I ask him to come watch… will big brother come? Will he… watch me run again?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: If I ask her to come watch… will big sister come? Will she… watch me run again?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: (And will they look at me again… with those sparkling eyes from last time…?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: With those eyes that always looked straight at me, with that shine… you always gave my legs the power to become invincible.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Hey. Someday, for sure, we will too—!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: “Yeah. We will too…!!”

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: “Yeah. We will too…!!”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: “Someday we’ll definitely reach a breathtaking view like that.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Yes, you were the one I made that precious, precious promise with.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huff…! Okay, that’s enough for the warm-up!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: So today we’re focusing on training on the woodchip course… right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You said you wanted to start at a relaxed intensity, right? Then… a pace of about 18 seconds per furlong?
choice_data_list: <size=32>No. I want to start at 20 seconds per furlong</size>
<size=32>No. I want to start at 20 seconds per furlong</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Eh, that’s pretty slow…! And the woodchip course is gentle on the legs, so—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Are you maybe really, really worried about me? I’m okay, you know? My body’s stronger than before.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I see… The outer loop course I told you about before— so it really had that many hard-ground spots?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I ran there yesterday too… so the stress on the bones must’ve built up. That’s why we should focus on the woodchip course with high cushioning—
choice_data_list: <size=32>But of course, we’ll increase the load gradually</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ……Yeah. Understood, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah… whew! 16-second pace, done…! Whew…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (For a moment… I kind of thought you were still my gentle, gentle “big brother”…)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (For a moment… I kind of thought you were still my gentle, gentle “big sister”…)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (But that’s not right. You’re a trainer now.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (…You became one for me, like this.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes!! I’m off!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Thanks for going over the plan leading up to competition day. I’ll work hard starting tomorrow too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: So, with that… that’s all for today’s meeting, right? If you’d like, want to take a break together? I’ll make some tea.
choice_data_list: <size=32>Ah, wait… before that, one more thing</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: <size=32>About the breathtaking view you’re aiming for—</size>
<size=32>About the breathtaking view you’re aiming for—</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: “What kind of breathtaking view do I want to reach,” huh…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I mean, sure, I admired Spe-san’s Japan Cup, but I’m not Spe-san. I can’t recreate the exact same scenery.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Of course, I have my own breathtaking view I want to reach! It’s not super concrete yet, though.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: A “breathtaking view that reaches everyone,” I think.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Carrying as many people’s hopes and dreams on my back as I can. Reaching that place together with as many people as possible—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: A strong, dazzling, glorious scene of victory. That’s the dream I’m aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That’s why I want to run in a way that moves everyone’s hearts. A way that makes someone fall in love at first sight and want to cheer forever.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I want to be an Umamusume who can light a powerful, powerful flame of expectation in everyone’s hearts.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ……Hehe. For a pre-debut girl, is that dream a little bold? You’re making that face.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: But I believe in it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I’m sure that someday, I’ll reach that breathtaking view I dream of. I believe that.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I’ve never once doubted this feeling. Not even once.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Ah… again.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Your face got a little tense.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Alright! This time for sure, the meeting’s over, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Then, let’s take a break together. …I’ll make some warm tea.
